leadText: Don't be afraid is the ending theme for the Korean dub of Everyone's Story. It is performed by .
plainText:
Don't be afraid is the ending theme for the Korean dub of Everyone's Story. It is performed by .

==Lyrics==
 
! Korean
! English

 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 

when the things are looking down
then look up don't be afraid
 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 

I can do anything if I'm next to you

Tell me, even the smallest of things
Joyful things, sad things
So that it doesn't get tough being alone
I'm here

I enjoy walking with you
Getting lost and wandering
Running, rolling and falling over
There is always us

I enjoy walking together
Let's be together always
Like you have always done
So that you won't think you're alone
Let's be together

When the things are looking down
Then look up don't be afraid
We are friends who look after you, Oo oo Yeah!

I enjoy walking with you
Getting lost and wandering
Running, rolling and falling over
There is always us

I enjoy walking together
Let's be together always
Like you have always done
So that you won't think you're alone
Let's be together

Dream to your heart's content
Jump around with strength
I'm there beside you
We can always smile

I enjoy walking together
Let's be together always
Like you have always done
Let's be together so that you won't think you're alone 

==Video==
